questions.passage: Nature may have an answer. The great tit (Parus major) is a bird in the tit family Paridae, about five inches in length. It is a common species in Europe, North Africa, the Middle East, and Central Asia. English zoologist John Richard Krebs and colleagues tested whether the great tits will “know” where to forage when two patches of vegetation differ in terms of availability of food.
questions.prompt: What did Krebs and colleagues test in the great tits?
options: Whether the birds could identify every species of plant.
Whether the birds would know where to forage when two vegetation patches differed in food availability.
Whether the birds preferred cities to all vegetation.
Whether all birds in four regions had identical body lengths.
questions.promptZh: Krebs 及同事在大山雀中测试什么？
optionsZh: 是否能识别所有植物种类。
两片植被食物供应不同时，是否会知道在哪里觅食。
是否喜欢城市胜过所有植被。
四地区全部鸟的体长是否相同。
analyses: A 研究问题是 forage，不是植物分类能力。
B two patches...differ...availability of food 直接描述任务。
C 没有城市选择条件。
D about five inches 是物种背景，并非测所有个体一样长。know 的引号也不证明鸟具有与人完全相同的主观认知。

evidence.quote: tested whether the great tits will “know” where to forage when two patches of vegetation differ in terms of availability of food.

questions.translation: 大自然也许有答案。大山雀 Parus major 属山雀科，约五英寸长，常见于欧洲、北非、中东和中亚。英国动物学家 John Richard Krebs 及同事测试，当两片植被的食物供应不同，大山雀是否会“知道”去哪里觅食。

evidence.quote: Nature may have an answer. The great tit (Parus major) is a bird in the tit family Paridae, about five inches in length. It is a common species in Europe, North Africa, the Middle East, and Central Asia. English zoologist John Richard Krebs and colleagues tested whether the great tits will “know” where to forage when two patches of vegetation differ in terms of availability of food.
